label: copy phase: fed-back w while outputting another w, early in a long copy (mostly sequences starting w w)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, and only when the input is the fed-back letter w (100% of activations have in_tok = w). Most of the mass (83%) is at recall_idx 1, where the input is orig(0) = w, and most of it comes when the next output is also w (out_tok w = 89% of mass), i.e. sequences that begin w w. Top activations are all w w ... with L = 8-9. Magnitude grows with the number of outputs still to go (larger L, earlier position) and is highest when both input and output are w. Weaker activations: input w at recall_idx 2-3, or output k (10% of mass). Does not fire in the original phase, at the delimiter, at recall_idx 0, or on any input other than w. It rarely fires for short sequences (L <= 4) even when they start w w, and it is silent on most later-copy w inputs. The predicate gets high precision (~0.82) but misses the weaker w-input activations at other positions or outputs (dev F1 0.62, mass recall 0.72).

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: recall_idx=1 & in_tok=w (+4.59), phase=2 & out_tok=w (+2.86), out_tok=w (+2.50), phase=2 & out_tok=k (+2.06), out_tok=k (+1.93), phase=2 & in_tok=w (+1.92). Lower it: in_count=1 (-1.60), next_out=- (-1.47), orig5=w (-1.36), orig8=- (-1.21).
